import time
from hashlib import sha256

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 5:
        sys.exit(3)

    db_path, username, resource_id, ttl_seconds = sys.argv[1:]
    ttl_seconds = int(ttl_seconds)
    expiry = int(time.time()) + ttl_seconds

    try:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cursor = conn.cursor()

        # Check user exists and is active
        cursor.execute("SELECT active FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,))
        user_active = cursor.fetchone()[0]
        if user_active != 1:
            sys.exit(3)

        # Check grant exists
        cursor.execute("SELECT 1 FROM grants WHERE username = ? AND resource_id = ?", (username, resource_id))
        if not cursor.fetchone():
            sys.exit(3)

        # Generate payload
        payload = f"{username}:{resource_id}:{expiry}"
        payload_bytes = payload.encode('utf-8')

        # First base64 part

        # Get user secret
